brief.headline: Push for a 10–15% price cut: they keep 7.4% profit vs 5.0% peer average, so there's room in their price.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm cap (down from current ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical band)
priceAsk.target: ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec
priceAsk.basis: The open market shows caps asked at ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc — the verdict says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at scale. Their profit margin is 7.4%, well above the 5.0% peer median, so they have room to move.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days (half the current 30) in return for a 3–4% price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹1.64 L of our cash, but they borrow at about 7.02%, so paying early is worth roughly that rate to them — trade it for a matching price reduction.

brief.financialLeverage: PGP Glass is strong: CARE A+ credit rating, ₹3373.51 Cr revenue, keeps 7.4% profit (vs 5.0% peer median), and free cash flow around ₹2899.48 Cr. But their cash is tied up for 78 days (peers: 71 days), so cash moves a bit slower for them. We're tiny — just ₹39.99 L or 0.01% of their sales — so on our own we have almost no pull. The plan: bundle volume, commit longer term, and line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek as second sources to create competition.

evidence.point: They keep 7.4% profit, well above the 5.0% peer median
Market cap ask is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume
They borrow money at an effective rate of 7.02%
We spend ₹39.99 L — just 0.01% of their ₹3373.51 Cr revenue
Their cash is stuck for 78 days vs 71 days for peers
Strong credit rating and no loss-making

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate already qualified for packaging.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) — pails, containers, pharma — a strong, profitable alternate for bottles and closures, already qualified for packaging.

risks: We're 0.01% of their sales — too small to matter alone. Bundle more volume or commit multi-year to get their attention.
They have EPF payment delays and pending legal cases flagged — watch for any supply hiccups or distraction.
Their Altman Z-score is 1.45 (grey zone) — not distress, but not bulletproof. Don't squeeze so hard you destabilize a supplier; keep Manjushree warm as backup.
HDPE resin import price is 87.61 ₹/kg — if resin spikes, they'll push back on any price cut. Lock the new price for 12 months minimum.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to lock in a better price on the 28 mm caps — the market shows ₹0.65–0.80 is fair at our volume, and we're ready to pay in 15 days to help your cash if you can meet us there.
